controller.sigma_rule: sigma_l(e) = q_l(e) * L[e][l]; q_l = width_l / width_l@32
controller.gmix_rule: T_alpha(h) = (1-alpha) h + alpha G_{q_l}(h), reference width 1; alpha=0 returns h unevaluated

trigger.rationale: SGD gradient norms plateau at a noise floor, so convergence is relative-plateau, not a threshold

stepper.rule: dsigma_l = -clip( (sigma_l/stages_left) * delta_ref * clip(median_l|dL/dphi_l| / |dL/dphi_l|, 1/kappa, kappa), dmin, dmax); direction fixed toward 0
stepper.variable: phi = exp(-1/(2 sigma^2)); NOT heat time sigma^2/2
stepper.exposure_note: sites are held at sigma_floor until the final scheduled stage so every arm spends the same number of updates at the exact target objective
stepper.normalisation: global median across filtered sites, in phi -- a per-site normalisation would collapse to uniform; kappa bounds the positive feedback of dividing by a sensitivity that itself falls with sigma

gap_trigger.rule: fire when (gap[-1-W]-gap[-1])/|gap[-1-W]| < eps, i.e. dwelling no longer reduces the distance to the target
gap_trigger.signal: L_target(theta) - L_current(theta) on the fixed probe
gap_trigger.caveat: the gap conflates function specialisation with BN statistic mismatch; both vanish at sigma=0
